# Cloud chat screenshot processing privacy, security, and recruiting-AI boundaries

- Status: accepted product and engineering baseline; qualified-counsel review
  is still required before processing production candidate data
- Checked: 2026-08-06
- Scope: Talent Signal sends intentionally imported chat screenshots or pasted
  text to a cloud multimodal model, proposes person and relationship-context
  binding, and generates traceable relationship memory, Agent hypotheses, and
  Wiki projections
- Primary launch assumption: recruiting workflows in mainland China, using the
  mainland-China region of Volcano Ark and the Doubao-Seed-2.0 family for
  direct image understanding without a separate OCR stage; EU and US expansion
  research remains in scope
- Source-language draft:
  [original Chinese research](../../_index/inbox/2026-08-06-cloud-screenshot-processing-privacy-zh.md)

> This is product and engineering research, not legal advice. Applicable law,
> legal basis, cross-border status, and high-risk recruiting-AI classification
> depend on the operating entity, service region, data center, model provider,
> contracts, actual features, and actual use. Qualified counsel in each
> jurisdiction must confirm the result.

## Conclusion

High-quality cloud models may process real chat screenshots, but privacy and
security cannot be added after launch. The first release must prove at least:

1. every processing operation has a defined purpose, legal basis, notice, and
   auditable record;
2. the recruiter, Talent Signal, and model provider have explicit processing
   roles and contractual responsibilities;
3. third-party, sensitive, and cross-border data in screenshots receive
   separate controls;
4. Agent recognition creates reversible source receipts and state proposals,
   never fact authority merely because model confidence is high;
5. authorization is enforced at contact, relationship, and assignment context,
   not only at account level;
6. source images, model extraction, assertions, Agent hypotheses, Wiki pages,
   vectors, caches, logs, and backups share one retention and deletion
   registry;
7. real candidate data does not enter model training, general analytics logs,
   or shared evaluation sets;
8. contextual interpretation cards do not affect candidate quality, fit,
   hiring probability, or automatic ranking.

“Compliant” cannot mean only that a privacy policy exists. The live system must
be able to produce a data inventory, processing records, contracts, impact
assessments, access audits, deletion receipts, supplier evidence, and incident
response evidence.

## 1. Whose data is processed, and by whom

A chat screenshot commonly contains:

- recruiter or client account information;
- candidate identity, contact, and job-search information;
- compensation, health, family, location, identity-document, financial, or
  other potentially sensitive information;
- third-party content from group chats, forwarding, or quoted messages;
- role plans, client plans, or other business-confidential information;
- motivation, relationship, or behavior hypotheses later generated by an
  Agent.

The first release does not require candidates to create Talent Signal accounts
or form a platform relationship with recruiters. This reduces the cost of a
two-sided account network but does not remove the data-subject status of
candidates or other people visible in a screenshot.

Contracts and product behavior should distinguish:

| Actor | Default role assumption | When it changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recruiter or recruiting organization | Determines why candidate data is processed and will usually be the personal-information handler or GDPR controller | May become a joint controller when new purposes are jointly determined with Talent Signal |
| Talent Signal | May act as an entrusted processor or GDPR processor when it only stores, extracts, and retrieves under customer instructions | Becomes an independent or joint decision-maker when it uses data for its own analytics, cross-customer knowledge, model training, or independent retention |
| Recognition or inference provider | Subcontracted processor or subprocessor | Cannot be treated as a pure processor if it independently trains, improves, or determines other uses |
| Candidates and other people in screenshots | Data subjects | Their rights and risks remain even without a product account |

The first contract-design principle is that technical access does not grant
Talent Signal an independent right to use candidate data. Product analytics
should record events and counts by default, not conversation bodies.

The default notice and rights split is:

- the recruiter or recruiting organization, as the party determining the
  recruiting purpose, owns the primary candidate notice, legal-basis decision,
  and rights-request entry point;
- Talent Signal supplies configurable notice materials, processing
  inventories, export, correction, deletion, and supplier-propagation
  capabilities and assists under the processor agreement;
- if Talent Signal decides to perform independent analytics, training,
  cross-customer learning, or another first-party use, it cannot rely only on
  the recruiter's notice and must assume the corresponding independent duties.

## 2. Mainland China baseline

### 2.1 Personal Information Protection Law

The [Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-08/20/c_1631050028355286.htm)
requires a clear and reasonable purpose, direct relevance, minimum impact, and
collection limited to the minimum necessary scope. Before processing, notice
must cover the processor, purpose, method, data types, retention period, and
rights method.

Possible legal bases include consent, entering into or performing a contract
to which the individual is a party, legally compliant human-resources
management, and other statutory grounds. A single bundled consent cannot be
assumed to cover every recruiting use.

Direct consequences for Talent Signal include:

- the recruiting organization must identify purpose and legal basis
  separately for screenshot capture, relationship memory, Agent retrieval, and
  later action;
- “possible future model improvement” is not the same purpose as current
  recruiting continuity;
- retention should be no longer than necessary for the purpose, not permanent
  by default;
- entrusted-processing contracts must specify purpose, duration, method, data
  categories, protection, return or deletion, and supplier oversight;
- candidates need workable access, copy, correction, deletion, restriction,
  and refusal paths;
- health, movement, financial-account, specific-identity, and other sensitive
  data require a specific purpose, strict necessity, protective measures, and
  separate consent when applicable;
- automated decisions must be transparent, fair, and impartial; an individual
  materially affected by an automated decision may request an explanation and
  refuse a solely automated decision;
- sensitive information, automated decision-making, entrusted processing,
  disclosure to another processor, export, and other high-impact processing
  require a personal-information protection impact assessment before
  processing, with reports and processing records retained for at least three
  years.

### 2.2 Network data security and compliance audits

The [Regulations on Network Data Security Management](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2024-09/30/c_1729384452307680.htm),
effective 2025-01-01, require a security system based on China's classified
cybersecurity protection scheme and controls such as encryption, backup, access
control, authentication, and incident plans. Entrusting or disclosing data
requires contractual controls, supplier oversight, and at least three years of
relevant processing records.

The [Measures for Personal Information Protection Compliance Audits](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-02/14/c_1741232791991016.htm),
effective 2025-05-01, require periodic compliance audits and more specific
audits at defined scale or when material risks or incidents arise. An early
product may remain below scale thresholds, but it should preserve audit
evidence from its first release.

Whether classified-protection grading, filing, or another industry obligation
applies depends on the actual network system, operator, and deployment. A
qualified China cybersecurity professional must confirm this before launch.

### 2.3 A small data volume does not automatically make an overseas model safe

The [Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2024-03/22/c_1712776611775634.htm)
distinguish security assessment, standard contract, and certification paths
and include volume thresholds. A non-critical information-infrastructure
operator exporting fewer than 100,000 people's non-sensitive personal
information may be exempt from specified filing, contract, or certification
procedures. That small-volume exemption expressly excludes sensitive personal
information.

Even when those procedures are exempted, Article 10 still requires notice,
separate individual consent, and a personal-information protection impact
assessment. Sensitive information, important data, critical
information-infrastructure status, or larger volume may change the path. The
[Measures for Personal Information Export Certification](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-10/17/c_1762449728518762.htm),
effective in 2026, further detail the certification mechanism.

Therefore:

- verify the model's actual processing region rather than the provider's
  corporate domicile;
- determine whether the supplier stores content, for how long, whether humans
  can access it, whether it is used for training, which subprocessors exist,
  and how deletion propagates;
- classify screenshot sensitivity instead of treating every image as ordinary
  personal information;
- support different models, data centers, and retention strategies for
  mainland-China and overseas regions;
- measure export volume continuously rather than creating records only after a
  threshold is reached;
- have counsel confirm the mechanism and legal basis against the operating
  structure.

### 2.4 Generative AI

Whether the [Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2023-07/13/c_1690898327029107.htm)
directly apply depends on whether Talent Signal is providing a generative-AI
service to the public in mainland China and on the actual service structure.
Their requirements concerning lawful data sources, non-discrimination,
privacy, personal information, accuracy, and transparency remain highly
relevant to this product's risk.

A model provider's general compliance claim does not replace Talent Signal's
responsibility for the specific screenshot purpose, export, subprocessors,
retention, and deletion path.

## 3. European Union baseline

### 3.1 GDPR

The [GDPR](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679)
requires lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, data
minimization, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity, and confidentiality.
Relevant Talent Signal obligations include:

- record an Article 6 legal basis for every processing purpose;
- separately analyze Article 9 special-category data such as health,
  politics, religion, or trade-union membership;
- evaluate Article 14 notice duties and exceptions when candidate data is
  obtained indirectly from recruiter screenshots;
- sign an Article 28 processing agreement with the model provider and manage
  subprocessors;
- implement data protection by default under Article 25;
- maintain Article 30 records of processing activities;
- use risk-appropriate Article 32 security measures;
- complete an Article 35 DPIA for high-risk new technology, systematic
  evaluation of people, or large-scale sensitive processing;
- use an applicable Chapter V mechanism and assess the destination for
  international transfers;
- support access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, objection,
  and automated-decision rights.

[EDPB Opinion 28/2024](https://www.edpb.europa.eu/documents/opinion-of-the-board-art-64/opinion-282024-on-certain-data-protection-aspects-related-to_en)
emphasizes that model anonymity must be assessed case by case. Reliance on
legitimate interests requires strict necessity and a balance against data
subjects' reasonable expectations and impact. Unlawfully processed model
development data can affect the lawfulness of later deployment.

### 3.2 EU AI Act

[EU AI Act Annex III](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32024R1689)
classifies AI used for recruiting, screening, analyzing applications, or
evaluating candidates as high risk. Narrow procedural or preparatory tasks, or
tasks improving a completed human activity, may fall outside that
classification under specified conditions. Profiling of a natural person
remains high risk.

For Talent Signal:

- source organization, structured extraction, and contact recall should remain
  narrow preparatory capabilities where the actual use supports that claim;
- using interpretation cards to decide who is more suitable, more likely to
  accept, or more stable approaches profiling and candidate evaluation;
- high-risk classification depends on intended and actual use, not whether the
  interface calls a feature “notes” or “insights”;
- any non-high-risk position needs written classification reasoning,
  prohibited uses, product controls, and use monitoring.

As of 2026-08-06, the European Commission states that the AI Omnibus effective
2026-07-27 moved the Annex III high-risk rules' application date to
[2027-12-02](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force).
The delay does not alter existing GDPR obligations and is not permission to
accumulate personality inference without reproducible sources or deletion.

## 4. United States baseline

The United States has no single product checklist covering every recruiting
and privacy scenario. The applicable analysis depends on state, city, data
type, and actual use.

- The [California Privacy Protection Agency](https://cppa.ca.gov/faq) explains
  that the employment-data exemption has expired. Covered businesses must
  support access, deletion, correction, and limits on sensitive-information
  use. ADMT, risk-assessment, and cybersecurity-audit rules finalized in 2025
  phase in from 2026; specified ADMT duties for significant employment
  decisions begin on 2027-01-01.
- [New York City Local Law 144](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/about/automated-employment-decision-tools.page)
  requires an independent bias audit, published results, and candidate notice
  for tools within its automated employment decision tool definition.
- [FTC security guidance](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/start-security-guide-business)
  emphasizes limiting collection, retention, and access from the start and
  verifying that service providers act consistently with contracts and
  representations. False or misleading privacy, security, or AI claims can
  also create enforcement risk.
- Federal and state anti-discrimination law continues to apply to hiring
  decisions. Once personality, health, communication style, or proxy variables
  enter ranking, the risk is no longer only data privacy.

Before a US launch, supplement this baseline with state-level privacy,
employment-AI, biometric, recording-consent, and breach-notification analysis
after service states and customer types are known.

## 5. Mainland-China launch model and processing decisions

### 5.1 Model path

The first release uses Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite in Volcano Ark's mainland-China
region for direct screenshot understanding, without a separate OCR service.
Deep thinking is disabled and output follows a fixed JSON contract.

The [current Volcano Ark getting-started guide](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1795150)
uses `doubao-seed-2-0-lite-260215` in a Beijing-region example and demonstrates
image input with `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}`. Production must pin and
record the specific console version rather than let an opaque `latest` alias
change extraction behavior.

The user-selected staged routing remains a decision to validate:

1. route every screenshot to Lite with thinking disabled to establish identity,
   context, fact, and `no_signal` baselines;
2. after stable evaluation, allow only clear, standardized screenshots into a
   Mini candidate path;
3. route blurred, multi-column, group-chat, forwarded, cropped, speaker-unknown,
   or cross-image cases back to Lite;
4. keep Pro out of ordinary extraction unless separate evidence later shows a
   need for complex cross-image tasks.

The same extraction model cannot be the sole judge of whether an image is
“clear.” Routing should combine observable image quality, layout features,
schema-validation results, and an offline gold-set evaluation. A Mini
validation failure falls back to Lite, but a successful fallback still does
not confirm business content as fact.

### 5.2 Point-in-time price check

The [Volcano Engine Doubao product page](https://www.volcengine.com/product/doubao/)
showed these starting online-inference prices on 2026-08-06, consistent with
the figures provided by the user:

| Model | Input starting price | Output starting price | Initial use |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Doubao-Seed-2.0-mini | CNY 0.2 per million tokens | CNY 2 per million tokens | Evaluate clear, standardized screenshots only after the baseline is stable |
| Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite | CNY 0.6 per million tokens | CNY 3.6 per million tokens | The first release's only default model and the later fallback for complex screenshots |
| Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro | CNY 3.2 per million tokens | CNY 16 per million tokens | Excluded from ordinary extraction |

These are point-in-time starting prices, not architecture constants or a cost
per screenshot. Image-token calculation, caching, rate limits, discounts, and
version changes require observation from real request billing.

### 5.3 Fixed JSON is an interface contract, not a truth guarantee

Fixed output must include:

- the source receipt and model, prompt, and schema versions;
- candidate person and relationship-context proposals with supporting
  evidence;
- explicit statements, speaker, time, and image location or another
  reviewable citation;
- `proposed`, `ambiguous`, `no_signal`, and other bounded states;
- uncertainty reasons, missing fields, conflicts, and user-review questions;
- explicit prohibition of personality scores, candidate ranking, hiring
  probability, and protected-trait output.

The service must parse the JSON and enforce schema, enum, length, resolvable
citation, and business-invariant checks. Parse failures, missing fields, or
unlocatable evidence enter safe retry or review. Natural-language guessing
must not fill missing structured fields.

### 5.4 Ark call and contract gate

Initial extraction should use a single inference request with no tool access
and set `store: false` when supported. The Volcano Ark
[Responses API documentation](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6492/2241840?lang=en)
states that a response with `store: false` cannot be retrieved by later API
calls. This describes API-session storage only; it does not prove the absence
of security logs, human access, other retention, or training use.

The [Doubao model service agreement](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1142195?lang=zh)
permits model use in customer products in mainland China while placing
lawfulness and third-party-rights responsibility on the customer. Before
contracting, obtain written evidence for the purchased API SKU confirming:

- customer input and output are not used for general model training,
  optimization, or human labeling;
- actual data centers, affiliates, and subprocessors;
- security-log content, retention, and content-access conditions;
- deletion, incident notice, audit, and regulatory-assistance mechanisms;
- commercial-use rights and the applicable data-processing agreement.

Do not treat a Doubao assistant product area as equivalent to the standard
inference API. Its current
[special terms and data-authorization agreement](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2047627)
include broad authority to process customer data for service optimization,
machine learning, and AI development and describe some used data as
non-revocable. Real recruiting screenshots must not enter a product path with
such terms.

## 6. Recommended data path

```text
User intentionally selects a screenshot or pastes text
→ show purpose, model region, and source-retention mode
→ encrypt and upload to tenant-isolated temporary source storage
→ send only the authorized current source to the contracted mainland-China model
→ cloud multimodal model performs direct structured extraction without separate OCR or tools
→ service validates the fixed JSON contract and evidence locations
→ save source receipt and produce identity, context, and fact proposals
→ route insufficient certainty to review
→ keep derived facts proposed even after automatic filing
→ complete required confirmation before recall, matching, or action is first affected
→ compile person page, Agent context, and Wiki only from the currently authorized context
→ on deletion, revoke retrieval first and then clear every registered derivative
```

### Automatic Agent filing boundary

After an intentional import, the system must not silently discard a source
because the model considers it unimportant. Correct behavior is:

- a successful upload creates a visible receipt;
- the model may return `no_signal`, meaning no explicit item should enter
  current state;
- the source image enters the visible Full source retention mode by default for
  re-review;
- only uniquely supported identity and context may show a pending item under a
  contact, while formal source binding and retrieval authority still await
  review;
- semantic similarity or personality inference alone cannot establish
  certainty;
- uncertain person, speaker, assignment, or relationship enters the review
  queue;
- automatic filing does not confirm a fact or authorize matching, ranking, or
  an external action.

The first release uses an explicit proposal/confirmation boundary:

| Write | Initial status | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| User import, file hash, import time, and retention choice | confirmed system event | The system directly observed the operation; it is not a model interpretation |
| Model-proposed person, speaker, relationship, assignment, and context binding | proposed | High confidence can still confuse same names, group chats, forwarded content, or message sides |
| Model-extracted motivation, constraint, commitment, deadline, and contextual interpretation | proposed | The source must remain available for correction, contest, and expiry |
| User selects a person or confirms one understanding | confirmed temporal state | The decision confirms only that field and context and does not widen other facts |
| Agent recommendation, reminder, match, or external action | proposal | Fact confirmation still does not authorize an action |

The system may display a proposal in a contact's pending area to reduce
organization work. It may not merge the proposal into unlabeled current fact
or widen the source's retrieval scope. Required identity, context, and
field-level review happens before it contributes to a person brief,
cross-contact search, reminder, or action proposal.

### One entry, context-authorized

One person page may aggregate navigation, but every item still needs:

- `person_id`;
- `relationship_context_id`;
- `assignment_id` or an explicit non-assignment context;
- source, speaker, time, purpose, and sensitivity;
- status: proposed, confirmed, contested, expired, superseded, or deleted;
- allowed consumers;
- retention policy;
- derivative registry.

The page opens in the currently selected relationship context. Cross-context
recall or search is deliberate and rechecks authorization at retrieval time.

## 7. Controls required in the first release

### Data and suppliers

- Maintain a data inventory and processing register for source, model
  extraction, state, note, hypothesis, Wiki, embedding, cache, log, backup, and
  evaluation data.
- For each model provider, record legal entity, region, data center,
  subprocessors, training use, human access, default and configurable
  retention, deletion capability, incident notice, and audit evidence.
- Execute entrusted-processing or DPA and confidentiality terms; prohibit
  general training on real screenshots.
- Never expose model credentials directly to clients; proxy each request
  through a backend that limits fields and purpose.
- Default extraction to `store: false`, no prior session, and no network or
  other tool access, and record request and supplier-policy versions.
- Pass identifiers rather than screenshot or conversation bodies through event
  buses, queues, and error tracking.

### Security

- TLS in transit and server-side encryption at rest;
- tenant isolation, least privilege, and short-lived source URLs;
- administrative access approval and content-access audit;
- key rotation, secret management, dependency, and vulnerability management;
- isolation of malicious source content and prompt injection;
- separation of production, development, analytics, and evaluation;
- encrypted backups, restoration tests, and deletion-aging policy;
- incident response, forensics, notice, and remediation plans.

### Retention and deletion

Retain three modes, with Full source as the first-release default for user
re-review. The exact duration still depends on purpose, jurisdiction, and
customer contract.

| Mode | Default behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Ephemeral | Delete the complete image after extraction and necessary review; retain only confirmed state and minimum evidence |
| Evidence crop | Retain encrypted local evidence related to material assertions, not the complete screenshot |
| Full source | Retain the complete encrypted source for re-review by default in the first release; let the user choose a shorter mode |

Law generally requires retention no longer than necessary; there is no single
duration that fits every recruiting screenshot. The product should supply a
conservative default, visible expiry, and deletion receipt rather than
permanent relationship memory. A tenant without a reviewed retention duration
and purpose-end rule cannot import real data into production.

Expiry of the complete image does not necessarily erase a confirmed fact that
still has a legal basis, but retained minimum evidence must explain the fact
and have its own expiry policy.

Deletion must:

1. immediately stop source and derivative retrieval;
2. remove source images, thumbnails, model-extracted text, and temporary files;
3. retract or recompile facts, interpretation cards, person pages, and Wiki;
4. remove embeddings, caches, search indexes, and evaluation copies;
5. propagate the request to model providers and subprocessors and preserve
   receipts;
6. age backup content on a written schedule while permitting secure storage
   only;
7. retain a minimum audit proof that contains no conversation body.

### Contextual interpretation cards

The user accepted flexible contextual interpretation cards serving the product.
The first release must keep them:

- source-traceable;
- explicit about candidate statement, recruiter observation, and Agent
  hypothesis;
- accompanied by at least one credible alternative explanation;
- limited to a relationship, assignment, and validity period;
- confirmable, contestable, expirable, and deletable;
- free of stable personality type, candidate score, hiring probability, or
  automatic ranking;
- free of proxy labels derived from health, family plans, religion, politics,
  disability, or other sensitive or protected information.

## 8. Real-data release gates

| Gate | Required release evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Jurisdiction and role | Operating entity, launch region, controller/processor split, and counsel conclusion |
| Data path | Complete device-to-backend-to-model-to-log-to-Wiki-to-backup data-flow diagram |
| Legal basis and notice | Purpose-specific records, recruiter agreement, and candidate-facing notice |
| Supplier | Standard Ark API SKU, DPA or entrusted-processing terms, region, subprocessors, training and retention evidence, and exclusion of broad data-authorization products |
| Cross-border | Data classification, volume ledger, PIPIA or DPIA, and applicable transfer mechanism |
| Identity and context | Same-name, group-chat, forwarding, message-side, and unknown-assignment tests; uncertain items enter review |
| Authorization | Account, tenant, person, relationship, and assignment access tests |
| Retention and deletion | Visible Full source default duration, immediate retrieval revocation, derivative deletion drill, and receipts |
| Logs and evaluation | No real conversation bodies in general logs and no real data in shared evaluation |
| Security | Encryption, key controls, least privilege, administrative-access audit, incident plan, and recovery test |
| Recruiting-AI boundary | Interpretation cards do not influence personality scoring, matching rank, or automated employment decisions |

Synthetic-data development may continue before these gates are met, but the
system cannot be represented as a compliant production system for real
candidate data.

## 9. Accepted product decisions

1. **Use one person entry with context partitions.** The user does not need to
   remember storage location, but the system preserves the relationship,
   assignment, time, and purpose under which each item is valid.
2. **Allow automatic filing of proposed state.** A supported source receipt may
   be written automatically; model extraction and identity binding remain
   proposals and must be visible and correctable before first business impact.
3. **Treat `no_signal` as a successful result.** Preserve the import receipt
   rather than silently discard the user's intent.
4. **Use a regional cloud multimodal model for mainland-China launch.** Route
   every first-stage screenshot to Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite with thinking disabled
   and a fixed JSON contract, without separate OCR. Mini routing requires real
   evaluation evidence; Pro is excluded from ordinary extraction.
5. **Share a derivative registry between privacy controls and Wiki
   compilation.** Content without registered provenance and derivation cannot
   enter a person page, embedding, or Wiki.
6. **Keep personality-related insight contextual.** It does not enter candidate
   ranking, screening, or hiring prediction.
7. **Retain the complete source by default for re-review, but not forever.**
   Duration, expiry, deletion propagation, and a user-controlled shorter option
   remain visible.
8. **Serve recruiters without creating candidate social accounts.** The
   recruiter or recruiting organization owns primary notice and legal-basis
   responsibility; Talent Signal supplies the rights-response capability
   required of its processor role.

## 10. External confirmation still required before launch

1. Qualified counsel must confirm the operating entity, recruiter-customer
   type, and specific personal-information-handler or processor roles in
   mainland China against contracts and actual behavior.
2. Written supplier materials must confirm the standard Volcano Ark inference
   API's actual data centers, subprocessors, training use, log retention,
   deletion, and incident notice rather than relying on marketing pages.
3. Purpose analysis, counsel review, and real recruiter workflow evidence must
   determine the concrete Full source default duration, assignment-close
   expiry, and customer configuration.
4. Candidate notice, identity verification for non-account data subjects, and
   rights workflows need an end-to-end exercise before real-data launch.
5. Mini routing may activate only after passing a gold set covering blurred
   images, same names, group chats, forwarding, cross-image context,
   `no_signal`, and deletion.
